thread.title: Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam at the right hand of power — the trial, Psalm 110 and Daniel 7 at his own mouth (Mark 14; Acts 7; Hebrews 1)
thread.old_summary:
It ain't new. The high priest puts him under oath, and the answer is two scriptures:

*Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.* (Matthew 26:64)

Mark hears the plain word before the scriptures:

*And Yahusha (Jesus) said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.* (Mark 14:62)

The seat is David's psalm:

*Yahuah (LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.* (Psalm 110:1)

He had already set that psalm before the Pharisees in the temple and asked them a question nobody answered:

*If David then call him Adonai (Lord), how is he his son?* (Matthew 22:45)

The clouds are Daniel's:

*I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* (Daniel 7:13)

*And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.* (Daniel 7:14)

Daniel says *like* the Son of Adam, because he was shown a figure who looked like a man and was more than one. At the trial the man standing in the room says it of himself without the *like*: the one Daniel saw is the one under oath, and the everlasting dominion of the next verse is his. Daniel keeps his *like*; the trial is where the name is claimed outright. The high priest understood both scriptures and what they say together:

*Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.* (Matthew 26:65)

He tore his clothes because the one at the right hand of Yahuah (the LORD), the one who comes with the clouds, had just said he was the man in front of him. He is Elohim (God) and he has a Father: the psalm has two speakers, the vision has the Ancient of days and the one brought before him, and the trial has the same two.

The seat was taken soon after. Stephen saw it, and the letters keep returning to it:

*But he, being full of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of Elohim (God), and Yahusha (Jesus) standing on the right hand of Elohim (God),* (Acts 7:55)

*Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;* (Hebrews 1:3)

And the coming with the clouds is still ahead, said in his own words on the mount and in John's words at the opening of the Revelation, each book speaking for itself:

*And then shall appear the sign of the Son of Adam in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of Adam coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.* (Matthew 24:30)

*Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.* (Revelation 1:7)

Two scriptures, said under oath, condemned him to death. They are the two the whole library goes on saying of him.

cards.note: Mark 2:10 — *But that ye may know that the Son of Adam hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)* *But that you may know that the Son of Adam has power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto you, Arise, and take up your couch, and go into your house.* (Luke 5:24) At the bed of the man with palsy, Yahusha (Jesus) already speaks of himself as the Son of Adam, who *hath power on earth to forgive sins*. Long before the trial he used that name for himself. The council later hears it again with the seat and the clouds attached.

cards.old_note: thread:sanhedrin-trial-tehillim-110-and-daniel-7-self-identification-at-the-kings-own-mouth | *When he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.* The Daniyel (Daniel) 7:13-14 Ancient-of-Days transfer-of-the-everlasting-kingdom architecture.
cards.note: Daniel 7:13 — *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* *Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of Adam be ashamed, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.* (Mark 8:38) Yahusha (Jesus) says the Son of Adam *cometh in the glory of his Father*. Daniel saw *one like the Son of Adam* brought near *before him*, the Ancient of days. There are two in the vision, one who comes and one he comes to, and the Son of Adam has a Father. Daniel's *like* stays Daniel's.

cards.src_text: Hereafter shall the Son of Adam sit on the right hand of the power of Elohim (God).
cards.tgt_text: Yahuah (LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
cards.old_note: thread:sanhedrin-trial-tehillim-110-and-daniel-7-self-identification-at-the-kings-own-mouth | *Hereafter shall the Son of Adam (son of man) sit on the right hand of the power of Elohim (God)* (Luke 22:69). The King's direct citation at the Sanhedrin trial of Tehillim (Psalm) 110:1 — *Yahuah (the LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand.* The Formed-Son names his own destination at the right hand of the Formless-Father in the very moment of condemnation. The Daniyel (Daniel) 7:13-14 Son-of-Adam cloud-rider claim joined to the Tehillim 110 right-hand-session.
cards.note: Psalm 110:1 — *Yahuah (LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.* *Hereafter shall the Son of Adam sit on the right hand of the power of Elohim (God).* (Luke 22:69) Luke gives only the seat. The psalm gives the voice that sets it: *Yahuah (LORD) said unto my Lord*. One speaks and one sits. Yahusha (Jesus) says he is the one who will sit there, until *thine enemies* become a *footstool*.

cards.src_text: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of Adam be ashamed, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
cards.tgt_text: Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
cards.old_note: thread:sanhedrin-trial-tehillim-110-and-daniel-7-self-identification-at-the-kings-own-mouth | The Matthean parallel of the same Sanhedrin-trial self-identification.
cards.note: Matthew 26:64 — *Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.* *Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of Adam be ashamed, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.* (Mark 8:38) He warned that the Son of Adam would come in glory, and here he says it to the men about to condemn him. He does not hide it. *Thou hast said*, he tells the high priest, and then names the seat and the clouds.

cards.old_note: thread:sanhedrin-trial-tehillim-110-and-daniel-7-self-identification-at-the-kings-own-mouth | Mark 14:62 — the same Son-of-Adam-coming-in-glory named under oath at the Sanhedrin trial; the disciples hear it here first.
cards.note: Mark 14:62 — *And Yahusha (Jesus) said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.* *Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of Adam be ashamed, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.* (Mark 8:38) On the road he spoke of the Son of Adam in the third person. Before the high priest he says *I am*, and the seat and the clouds follow in the same breath. The title he used of himself is now claimed plainly, under oath, in front of those who could condemn him.

cards.note: Psalm 110:1 — *Yahuah (LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.* *And they led Yahusha (Jesus) away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.* (Mark 14:53) They led Yahusha (Jesus) to the high priest, with the chief priests, elders and scribes gathered. cards.old_note: thread:sanhedrin-trial-tehillim-110-and-daniel-7-self-identification-at-the-kings-own-mouth | The Daniyel (Daniel) 7:13-14 cloud-rider architecture spoken at the high priest's own question.
cards.note: Daniel 7:13 — *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* *And they led Yahusha (Jesus) away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.* (Mark 14:53) The whole court is gathered, and the high priest's question puts Daniel's vision in the room. Daniel saw *one like the Son of Adam* and *they brought him near* the Ancient of days. The man standing before the court says the figure is himself, and he says it without the *like*.

cards.src_text: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of Elohim (God).
cards.tgt_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
cards.old_note: thread:sanhedrin-trial-tehillim-110-and-daniel-7-self-identification-at-the-kings-own-mouth | The Sanhedrin asked who he claimed to be; the ascension answered the question in act (Mark 14:62 echo).
cards.note: Mark 14:62 — *And Yahusha (Jesus) said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.* *So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of Elohim (God).* (Mark 16:19) At the trial he said *ye shall see* the Son of Adam *sitting on the right hand of power*. Mark ends with him received up, and he *sat on the right hand of Elohim (God)*. The seat is no longer only promised. The book that records the promise records the taking.

cards.member_note: Mark 14:62 — *I am: and ye shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power.* What was said at the trial about the seat is told in Mark as done.

cards.src_text: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of Elohim (God).
cards.tgt_text: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
cards.old_note: thread:sanhedrin-trial-tehillim-110-and-daniel-7-self-identification-at-the-kings-own-mouth | Hebrews 1:3's *sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high*.
cards.note: Hebrews 1:3 — *Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;* *So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of Elohim (God).* (Mark 16:19) Mark says he *sat on the right hand of Elohim (God)*. Hebrews says it again in other words: he *sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high*, when *he had by himself purged our sins*. The same seat is told twice, once as an act and once as a name.
